metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-nj[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Log Recall: Ctrl+N/P phrase history for Schedule, Work, Rotten, and[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Cancel Log prompts[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every free-text prompt in Obsidian and Bob Mac Capture that writes [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a Schedule, Work, Rotten, or Cancel Log entry can reuse a reason [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]typed earlier for any task in two keystrokes. Ctrl+N/P move through[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a visible "USED BEFORE" band that is filtered by the draft and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ranked by recent and frequent use. The band fills the field, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Enter still writes exactly the text the field shows. The four [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]histories are derived read-only from the vault by `bob logs list`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]so they need no new store, have no cold start, and pick up note [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]edits and deletions on their own.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]log_reason_recall.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/log_reason_recall.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-nj[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-nj/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-cli: vault-derived log phrase catalog and `bob logs list`[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]logs-catalog[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]logs-catalog: add a cached scanner over task Schedule, Work, Rotten, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Cancel Logs. It filters out machine-written text using a classifier [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]backed by a writer registry test, then ranks by tiered literal match [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus newest-pinned frecency. It ships the read-only `bob logs list` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](human and JSON output), the shared rank vectors, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs/log-recall.md contract.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-plugins: recall store, model, band decorator, and the Work[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]Log modals[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]recall-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]after logs-catalog[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recall-core: add a ledger-tools `api.logs` store (stale-while-revalidate[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus a session overlay) and nav's pure model and `attachLogRecall` band [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decorator with styles. Expose `api.logRecall` v1 and wire [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]TaskLinkLanePromptModal, LaneReleaseSummaryModal (which also gets the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]standard preview and footer), and block-id-prompt's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]WorkSummaryPromptModal.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-plugins: Task Card picker log stages[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]picker-stages[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recall-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]picker-stages: attach recall to the schedule-review form (a Schedule [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reason field and a Work summary field sharing one band that follows [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]focus) and to the schedule-work-log, lane-release-reason, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cancel-reason stages. Ctrl+N/P route through the picker keydown mixin, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Esc and Ctrl+[ back out in layers, and the writers call noteUsed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-plugins: Rotten keep prompts and the successor inline [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]cancel reason[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]rotten-and-successor[dim] · [dim][/dim]after recall-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rotten-and-successor: attach Rotten recall to RottenKeepReasonStage [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](single keep and decay-card Stay) and to the batch keep form (which gets[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the standard footer). Attach dense Cancel recall to the successor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]picker's inline reason, with a blur-commit guard. Wire noteUsed into the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rotten and successor-cancel writers.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-mac-capture: pull-in cancel reason recall[/bold #D7AFFF]                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-cancel-recall[dim] · [dim][/dim]after logs-catalog[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-cancel-recall: in CaptureCore, decode the `bob logs list` JSON and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add the ranking (tested against the vendored vectors), the recall state,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the band presentation. Add a gated 3-row USED BEFORE band under [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]CapturePullInReasonField, plus router Ctrl+N/P and ↑/↓, Esc layering, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the blur guard. Gate on exact-SHA macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-cli: Work Log phrase completion in capture-complete[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]capture-log-complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after logs-catalog[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-log-complete: add an additive `pomodoro_close_log_summary` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-parse span and a `work_log` capture-complete context. Its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]history candidates replace only the entry summary, never preselect, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]require two typed characters.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-mac-capture: inline Work Log recall in the completion [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]popup[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]mac-worklog-recall[dim] · [dim][/dim]after capture-log-complete, mac-cancel-recall[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-worklog-recall: request completion inside close-log summary spans, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decode the `work_log` context, and render USED BEFORE history rows. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Return accepts only a selected row; otherwise it keeps today's behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Gate on exact-SHA macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision record, glossary term, and cross-repo docs sweep[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]recall-memory[dim] · [dim][/dim]after picker-stages, rotten-and-successor, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]mac-worklog-recall[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recall-memory: write the Log Recall decision record and glossary term [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through /sase_memory_write, citing the landed commits. Verify that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs/log-recall.md, the plugin reference, and the Mac docs agree with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the shipped behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
